action_instruction: Checking whether displayed runs belong to Acme
intent: whether every displayed run in the Kane runs list links to an Acme post

action_params.condition: Every displayed run belongs to Acme.
action_params.query: whether every displayed run in the Kane runs list links to an Acme post
action_params.code_js: (() => { const rows = [...el(15).querySelectorAll('[data-testid="run-row"]')]; return rows.length > 0 && rows.every(row => [...row.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].some(a => new URL(a.href).pathname.startsWith('/acme/'))); })()
